title: nan
authors: Swamidoss I.N.; Al Mansoori A.; Shajahan S.; Bouamer T.; Al Remeithi H.; Al Marzooqi A.; Sayadi S.
key_contribution: Proposes a novel optical flow method for UAV velocity estimation for vision-based navigation in GPS-denied low-feature environments, evaluated against multiple optical flow methods.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
